newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Paul Harris '96 EPS estimate upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Paul Harris '96 EPS estimate upped.

text.p: -- HD Brous & Co analyst Howard Rosencrans said he will raise his 1996 earnings estimate for Paul Harris Stores Inc to $0.66 from $0.60 to reflect the company's better-than-expected third-quarter earnings.
-- The company on Tuesday reported third quarter net income of $0.17 per share, its highest for that period. It lost $0.06 per share during the third quarter last year.
-- Rosencrans called the third-quarter earnings a "blowout," at more than 50 percent above his forecast of $0.11 per share.
-- Rosencrans said his fourth-quarter 1996 estimate will remain at $0.47 cents and his 1997 estimate will stay at $1.00, which he called on the high side of other estimates.
